product_metadata.title: HAKACC Bedside Caddy/Bedside Storage Organizer,Remote Control Holder Armchair Organizer Couch Caddy Sofa Armrest Bag for tablet Magazine Phone Remotes, Black
features: WHAT YOU GET - 1PC Black Bedside Storage Bag

PREMIUM QUALITY - Our bedside caddy is made of 90% linen and 10% leather, nontoxic and odorless, heavy-duty and tear-resistant, durable and reusable, wrinkle-resistant and easy to care, colorfast and no shrinking after wash.
LARGE CAPACITY - Our bedside caddy can hold up to 12 pounds.Meet more storage needs and organization needs.
NON-SLIP DESIGN - You just need to tuck the flat board into the bed mattress and the leather side will build up a lot of friction with the mattress to prevent the organizer from dropping.

WIDELY APPLICABLE - 3 mesh pockets are perfect to contain remote control, cell phone, eye glasses, headphone, pens, bottle, snacks and other gadgets. The A4-size pocket is suitable for books, tablet, magazines, notebooks, and more. Our bedside caddy is suitable for bedside, bed rails, bunk beds, sofa, ideal for home, bedroom, living room or dorms.
